description.narrative: The purpose of the preparatory study is to create a foundation for a pilot project between STC and YFC. Manara Youth Center (MYC) is one of the YFC�s centres and will be the center, that STC will collobrate with. MYC is located in the community of Bourj Hammoud, Beirut. The area is known for its diversity (religious, ethnic, economic) as many refugees from different countries and regions have settled over the last 30 years. This pilot project will focus on supporting young people to use their voices and share their experiences. Together with Manara Youth Center, STC will explore how to create a sustainable mental health ambassador program for young people, based on the principle: "training of trainers''. The purpose of the project is to introduce and facilitate dialogic tools where participants have the opportunity to share their perspective on their experiences of the world.
